loom.claims_status: All LoomKV algorithm/benchmark/test entries below are author-reported in paper v1, not independently reproduced.

hardware_transfer.port_inference: Replace Hopper TMA path with an SM89-supported copy pipeline; re-evaluate register/smem occupancy, alignment, tails, barriers and fragment layouts.

memory_and_failures.inference: A finite overflow area and average fallback frequency do not prove worst-case token capacity; repeated recompute of the same incompressible data need not resolve overflow exhaustion.

recommendations: Treat Tier and Pool as separate interfaces and milestones.
Keep active_gpu_generations=1 and avoid inheriting concurrency-goodput claims.
Calibrate the exact target model/revision/weight format before using any ratio for budgeting.
Budget actual physical allocations, padding, metadata, temporary workspaces and overlap peaks.
Specify terminating overflow/import-failure handling and event/refcount-based reclamation.
SM89 Pool needs a non-TMA implementation and numerical quality validation.
Benchmark same-shape raw/compressed kernels and end-to-end latency separately.
Disable compression if measured capacity/reuse benefit does not repay its cost.

findings.claim: An exhausted raw side pool can select raw tile 0 and still write raw data/mode metadata before the delayed host-side error check.
findings.derivation: idx<0 causes r_new=0 via masked load other=0 and increments err. Neither need nor is_new are disabled on allocation failure; raw store and mode-table store still execute. Existing raw tile0 may be overwritten. Host check reads prior err_host only every16steps, then schedules asynchronous copy of current err.
findings.required_gate: Reserve valid raw capacity before mutation; on failure leave old cache/page map intact and fail or commit safe raw elsewhere. Fault injection must prove no corruption or invalid output can escape.

findings.claim: The paged head_dim128 path hardcodes 1/sqrt(D); backend self.scale reaches the256path but not128.
findings.required_gate: Reject nondefault scale for128 or implement scale propagation and compare reference attention at several scales; never silently change model attention semantics.

findings.claim: Paged kernels support GQA groups1,2,4,6,8, whereas standalone supports1..8 and README broadly says<=8.
findings.required_gate: Require n_q divisible by n_kv and G in actual selected kernel dispatch set.

findings.claim: supports_compute_capability returnsTrue unconditionally; that is not proof the third-party kernels support every GPU.
findings.required_gate: Probe CUDA device/compute capability/toolchain; verify compile forSM89 and correctness before enabling. Unsupported environments explicitlySKIP and remainraw.

findings.claim: Published vLLM interface is BF16-only, decoder attention, head_dim128/256; several attention semantics explicitly rejected.
The adversarial codec test removes NaN/Inf bit patterns; tests do not establish all-payload and signedzero coverage.
findings.required_gate: Exhaustively test all65536BF16 bitpatterns through integer views, all256FP8 bitpatterns, arbitrary mixed pages; validate NaNpayload andsignedzero bybytes.

findings.claim: Bit-exact KV reconstruction does not prove bit-exact attention/logits/tokens when changing kernels; GAAC tests use numerical tolerance and build uses fast math.
findings.required_gate: Separate byte-roundtrip criterion from attention tolerance and generation-level acceptance; if strict output identity is required, custompool kernel must meet it orstaydisabled.

findings.claim: Page.nbytes excludes bases and usesS although allocated streams can useS_pad; reference-only offsets andscratch/reservations also exist.
findings.required_gate: Report serialized bytes and live/peak GPU allocations independently; include bases,indices,padding,rawfallback,scratch.
